jobs.description:
Are you a cheerful multitasker with a driver's license? 🚗💨 Then we are looking for you as a delivery driver for AH Online! Get started at Albert Heijn in Dordrecht, and discover the flexible working hours. 📅

After 13 weeks you also earn €18,83 per hour! NICE! 💰 This great job is a real #baanrader! 🤩

Would you like to know more about this position? Then read on! 👇

What we offer
- Earn € 150 when you bring a friend!
- Earn € 18,83 per hour after thirteen weeks!
- Full-time, and part-time options
- Flexible working hours
- Travel allowance
- An in-house Tempo-Team office!

Who you are
As a delivery driver for Albert Heijn Online, you are physically able to lift heavy crates. You can also work independently to deliver groceries on time. What else you need to know:

- You speak English or Dutch;
- You are in possession of a driving license B for at least six months;
- You have private transport to get to the location.

What will you do
No day is the same as a delivery driver for Albert Heijn Online. But that's also what makes the work so much fun! You start each shift by collecting the key and the route lists. You can also take something tasty from the refrigerator with you for the road. Time to deliver! You drive to the right locations via your navigation. Here, you can deliver your groceries to your door. You also check the payment like a real professional. Everything arranged? Time to leave again! You get into the van and return to the depot. Here, you clean the car for the next working day. Ready to hit the road again! Do you enjoy it so much that you want to continue growing after a while? Then you can always become a buddy, for example!

Where will you work
Working as a delivery driver for Albert Heijn Online means a lot of contact with different people. In other words: a nice and fun team! You will meet each other in the waiting area during each service. A great opportunity to get to know each other even better! Drink a cup of coffee together! Or get so

Are you looking for a new challenge in the logistics sector?Do you enjoy working in a friendly and supportive team and are you willing to work in two shifts with bonuses up to 150%? Then this warehouse position at AS Watson or Kruidvat might be perfect for you! Keep reading!

As an order picker/warehouse employee, you’ll be responsible for collecting orders using a voice-picking system, which can be set in multiple languages, including Dutch, English, and Polish. Together with your team, you’ll make sure all orders are ready on time for stores in the Netherlands and Belgium.

You’ll use your organizational skills to efficiently load products onto pallets. These pallets can include items like toothpaste, shampoo, cleaning supplies, toys, and clothing. Since no two pallets are the same, every day brings new challenges.

At AS Watson, you’ll work in a two-shift schedule and receive attractive bonuses of up to 150% per hour for late shifts. Plus, you’ll be part of a friendly team where collaboration is key.

- You work accurately and take responsibility
- Willing to work in two shifts (06:00 - 14:00 and 14:00 - 22:00)
- Flexible availability, part-time options possible
- Minimum availability on Mondays and Tuesdays, plus two Saturday mornings per month
- Own transportation required, as the location is not easily accessible by public transport

As a metalworker, you play a key role in manufacturing high-quality metal components finished to perfection. You ensure that components are ground and finished with extreme precision using grinding equipment, where your craftsmanship is directly reflected in the quality of the final product.

Using technical drawings and clear specifications, you work accurately and with great attention to detail. You independently set up machines and select the correct grinding tools for the job. Throughout the process, you continuously monitor dimensions and quality, taking pride in delivering top-quality products.

In this position, you will have the opportunity to further develop your technical knowledge and experience within a professional working environment where safety, teamwork, and craftsmanship are central. Your contribution makes a real difference in a team that works together to create strong, durable, and technically advanced products.

- Interest in hands-on work
- Accuracy and attention to quality
- Good command of the English language, both spoken and written
- Affinity with technology is a plus, but polishing experience is not required

QC Officer 
We are looking for a Quality Inspector for our location in Waddinxveen. Do you have an eye for detail and plenty of energy? Would you like to work in an enthusiastic and informal team with a no-nonsense mentality? Then come work with us. 
 What will you do? 
As a Quality Inspector at Roveg Fruit, you work at the heart of a broad and diverse assortment of exotic fruits, vegetables, and fresh produce. Beautiful products arrive daily from all over the world and must continue their journey through our warehouse, production department, and ultimately to the customer. 
The Production Quality Inspector is an essential link between the ripening process, order picking, and the repacking department. You monitor and assess the quality of the production process and prepare quality reports. These reports cover production quality and, when necessary, stock quality. 
You inspect products according to customer specifications to ensure they meet all requirements. Using your expertise, you assess product quality so that the sales team can correctly advise customers. You support the commercial department by clearly indicating the quality level of the products, contributing to the marketability of our assortment. 
You also provide instructions to the production department to ensure that the final output (repacking, packaging, sorting, labeling) meets customer requirements. As a specialist in retail specifications, you share responsibility for the final quality check before products leave the warehouse. 
 - MBO - Dutch and English 
 Who are you? - Experience in quality control within the fresh produce (AGF) sector - Minimum MBO+ level of education and thinking - Strong communication skills - Proficiency in Dutch and/or English, spoken and written - Willingness to work in rotating shifts

Do you like to roll up your sleeves, stay physically active, and prefer working during the day? For our logistics center, we are looking for enthusiastic team players to join us. Together with great colleagues, you will ensure the daily flow of goods runs smoothly!

What we offer
- € 15,20 bruto per hour!
- Weekly salary paid!
- Working in a close team!
- Plenty of opportunities for advancement!
- Work the day shift, so free in the evening!
- Easily accessible by public transport!

Who you are
We are looking for someone who has the following:

- You enjoy physical work (sorting and lifting boxes).
- You speak and understand either Dutch or English.
- You are able to provide a certificate of good conduct (VOG).

What will you do
In this role, you will be on the move all day in the warehouse. Your main focus will be sorting, lifting, and processing various incoming and outgoing boxes. It is a hands-on job, so you can definitely skip the gym after work!

Where will you work
You will be working in a large and fast paced logistics center. The atmosphere in the warehouse is informal and nice: everyone works hard to get the job done, but there is always time for a laugh or a quick chat with your colleagues. The team is highly diverse and international, making it a welcoming place for everyone. Whether you speak Dutch or English, you will be part of the crew from day one!
